settings.heading: At Woodeca, we make furniture for real homes.
settings.text: Furniture shopping in Egypt usually comes with the same trade-off: showroom markups, middlemen adding their cut at every step, or waiting weeks just to see a price. Woodeca started with a simple idea: good furniture shouldn't cost more just because of the road it takes to reach you. So we design and build every piece in our own factory in Borg El Arab, Alexandria, and sell it straight to you.
We're an Egyptian furniture maker, designing and building in our own factory and delivering straight to homes across Egypt.

settings.heading: Made in our own factory
settings.text: Every Woodeca piece is made by our own team in Borg El Arab. Because we handle every step, from the first cut to the final quality check, we know exactly what goes into your furniture, and we stand behind it.

settings.heading: Built to last
settings.text: We build furniture for everyday life: busy mornings, growing kids, moving house. Every piece is checked before it leaves the factory, and it's backed by our 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects.

settings.heading: Fair, factory-direct prices
settings.text: No showroom markup and no middlemen adding their cut. You pay for the furniture, not the supply chain. And you choose how to pay: cash on delivery, card or instalments.

settings.heading: Customer-first
settings.text: Real people, ready to help before and after you buy. Check your order at your door before you pay, take 14 days to return or exchange, and reach our team whenever you need us.
